name: Cristian-Ioan Vasile
title: Assistant Professor; Explainable Robotics Lab lead
department: Mechanical Engineering and Mechanics; Computer Science and Engineering (courtesy)
fitReason: Direct intersection of formal task specifications and policy learning, with recent sim-to-real evaluation rather than merely symbolic planning examples.

physicalEvidence.summary: September 25, 2026 STL-SVPG preprint is a Penn–Lehigh collaboration including Vasile. Section VII-E tests learned policies on a physical brushless Crazyflie with a printed cage and RealSense ball tracking. Random Cue succeeds in 37/60 hardware episodes. Ping-pong transfers contact but achieves only 1/60 complete successful episodes; the paper reports another target hit followed by a crash. Panda tasks are simulated. This proves participation in a hardware project, not current ownership of this platform at Lehigh.
